_doc: Corrections to the hand-typed POL-035 snapshot where the snapshot does not match the printed article.
Applied by generate_xml.py after the slash decisions. Each entry names the node, the snapshot text it
expects (the build stops if the snapshot differs), and the text to publish. drop_variants removes any
alternate FORM the snapshot gives the node.
